findings.title: Pass the actual query results to the new table visualization
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, every dashboard table receives `columns={[]}` and hard-coded empty data and metadata instead of the fetched `result`. Consequently, enabling the feature replaces populated dashboard tables with empty tables. Wire the result's rows, metadata, and configured columns into the new visualization before selecting this branch.

findings.title: Include the organization in the attribute query cache key
findings.body: The new React Query key contains only a constant and query options; it no longer includes the organization-specific endpoint path. Two organizations with the same date range and project selection (for example, the all-projects selection) therefore share a cache entry even though the query function requests different organization endpoints. Switching organizations can display the previous organization's custom attribute names and can cause concurrent consumers to reuse the wrong request. Include the organization slug or ID in the key.

findings.title: Normalize timestamp units before merging errors with recording events
findings.body: Error event timestamps from nodestore are Unix seconds, whereas raw replay recording events use rrweb timestamps in milliseconds. Comparing these values directly causes essentially every error to be emitted before the first recording event, even when it happened later in the replay. This gives Seer incorrectly ordered context. Convert both timestamps to the same unit before comparing them, and test with realistic millisecond recording timestamps rather than the second-valued fixtures currently used.
